title: zard/ui registry index
description: The index a registry publishes at /r/registry.json. It carries what is needed to resolve an install, never the source code, which lives in the individual item files at /r/<name>.json.

schemaVersion.description: The shape of this file, not the version of the package — that is `version`. It rises when a change breaks readers (a field removed, a meaning changed); a new optional field does not raise it. A client that reads up to a lower version should refuse the registry and say so, instead of misreading it. Absent means 1, from before the field existed.

version.description: The release the content was built from. Informational: use schemaVersion to decide whether you can read it.

basePath.description: The directory the files are written into, when it differs from the item's name.

dependencies.description: npm packages the item needs at runtime.

registryDependencies.description: Other items of this registry that must be installed alongside.

minAngularMajor.description: The lowest Angular major the item's source compiles on. `zard-cli add` stops with a message on an older project instead of installing files that do not build.

files.description: The file names of the item. The contents are in /r/<name>.json.

build.description: What the item needs from the project's build, beyond npm packages and its own files. `zard-cli add` applies it: it wires the global stylesheet and the build assets of the project, and prints the snippet to paste where it cannot edit the file.

styles.description: Imports the global stylesheet needs, in this order and unlayered.

import.description: A specifier resolved from node_modules, e.g. maplibre-gl/dist/maplibre-gl.css.

file.description: One of the item's own files, imported by its path relative to the stylesheet.

assets.description: Static files the build copies to the output root, in the shape of an Angular build assets entry.

icons.description: The icons the component draws, and the set they are written in. Present on every item; the lists come back empty for a component that draws none, which is how 'uses no icons' is told apart from 'published before this field existed'.

family.description: The icon set the published files are written in. A client installing with another set translates the symbols using /r/icons.json.

symbols.description: The identifiers as they appear in the code (lucideCheck).

tokens.description: The same icons by the set-neutral key of the translation table (check).

icons.$comment: The index carries only these three. The icons of the demos are in the item file, described by registry-item.json — the index is fetched on every command and does not need them.
